chapter: Heroes, heard bands and Lunceford's life on the road
title: First hearing Ellington's band in Buffalo
summary: Crawford first heard Ellington's band in Buffalo around 1931-33 and says Lunceford's men went to hear it.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Where did you first hear Duke's band?
Yeah, 'round about -- about '31 or -2, -3, 'round in there somewhere. I hit New York in '33.
Where did the rest of the people in Lurceford's your band, in Lunsford's band, did many of the other band members go to hear Ellington's band when he came to Buffalo?

Oh, yeah, the ones that were in there. Oh, that was -- Ellington was Ellington then and still is. Of course, I don't know what kind of band he assemble now. Russell Procope and Sonny Greer are playing downtown in some place. I've been intending to go by there whenever they are in the club, night club.
